title: Regression to the Mean
coreMove: treat the rebound from an extreme result as regression before assigning credit or blame
sourcePressure: shows that extreme outcomes are often followed by more ordinary ones without praise or blame causing the shift
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: using regression as a synonym for decline instead of return toward average after extremity
